verdict.reasons: Core defect identified: The commercial tape roll shown is flat, and the tape emerging from it is also visibly flat and ribbon-like. Additionally, two continuous black parallel lines are present running down the crop rows. While the prompt allows 'ordinary headers' and 'fittings', the presence of a second continuous parallel line alongside the tape is highly suspicious. Drip tape typically unrolls into a single continuous lateral line. The visual of a wide flat ribbon running parallel to a round tube (or two round tubes) represents mixed product families (tape vs hose) and creates an irrigation geometry that is impossible and technically inaccurate for drip tape systems. Drip tape does not exhibit this double-line structure. The observed_family is therefore 'mixed' and technical_evidence_match is false, failing the minimum score threshold.
